name: El Paso Health Youth Volunteer Program (EPHY)
what_you_do: Help with community health projects and learn how the local health care system works. The program also lets youth speak up about local health policy.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 18. Volunteers 13 to 17 need a parent or legal guardian to sign a waiver.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Download the form from the program page and fill it out. Email it to EPHConnections@elpasohealth.com. The program page lists no phone number for the volunteer program.
notes: The program page lists last year's totals: 3,344 backpacks, 331,947 pounds of food and 404 car seats. The totals are not dated.
